tools.name: ask_fo
tools.description: Send the user's request to Fo, a professional bits-to-atoms mover: Fo takes what the user asks for here and gets it done in the real world from their own Wajo account. It can read and send their email, manage their calendar, place calls, make purchases, and use the integrations they have connected. Continues the user's current Fo conversation by default; pass conversationId (from list_fo_conversations or an earlier reply) to continue a specific one, or set newConversation only when the user clearly changes topic or asks for a fresh start. Long turns return status="working" with a progress line: then keep calling get_fo_reply yourself (each call waits up to 40 seconds) and relay its progress to the user in a sentence until the status is complete or failed; do not send another ask_fo until it settles, and never ask the user to check back. If a reply says Fo is waiting for the user's answer, put Fo's question to the user and send their answer with ask_fo instead of polling. The conversationId is an internal handle: never show it to the user.

message.description: The user's request for Fo, verbatim. Required.

conversationId.description: Continue a specific Fo conversation (an id from list_fo_conversations or an earlier reply). Omit to use the current conversation.

newConversation.description: Start a fresh Fo conversation instead of continuing the current one. Default false. Not combinable with conversationId.

response.description: Fo's reply when complete, or polling guidance when working.

conversationId.description: The conversation the turn ran on. Internal handle; never show it to the user.

progress.description: While working: a one-line account of what Fo is doing, to relay to the user.

elapsedSeconds.description: While working: seconds since the turn began.

tools.name: get_fo_conversation
tools.description: Read the recent transcript of one of the user's Fo conversations (the most recent ~40 turns, oldest first). Pass a conversationId from list_fo_conversations. Use it to recall what the user and Fo discussed before continuing the thread with ask_fo.

conversationId.description: The conversation to read, from list_fo_conversations. Required.
Server-issued id; pass it back as conversationId.

title.description: Display name, "Untitled" when the session has none.

channel.description: Originating channel: chat (web, app, or ChatGPT), email, sms, whatsapp, telegram, slack, voice, cron, hook, x.

turns.description: The most recent turns, oldest first. Absent when there are none.

runId.description: The run that produced the turn; a conversation.reply webhook carries the same runId. Absent when unknown.

tools.name: get_fo_reply
tools.description: Wait for and fetch Fo's reply after ask_fo returned status="working". Each call waits up to waitSeconds (default 40) for Fo to finish or take its next step, then returns status="complete" with the reply, "failed" with a user-safe explanation, or "working" with a fresh progress line and elapsedSeconds. While the user is waiting, keep calling this yourself and relay progress in one sentence so they know Fo is on it; never ask the user to check anything or come back later. If the response says Fo is waiting for the user's answer, put Fo's question to the user and send their answer with ask_fo instead of polling. After roughly ten minutes of "working", tell the user Fo is still on it and keeps working even if they leave, and ask whether to keep waiting. Pass the conversationId the ask_fo reply carried, or omit it for the current conversation; it is an internal handle, never show it to the user.

conversationId.description: The conversation to poll (from the ask_fo reply). Omit to poll the current conversation.

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for Fo to finish before answering. Default 40; 0 answers immediately.

response.description: Fo's reply when complete, polling guidance when working, a user-safe explanation when failed.

conversationId.description: The conversation polled. Internal handle; never show it to the user.

progress.description: While working: a one-line account of what Fo is doing, to relay to the user.

elapsedSeconds.description: While working: seconds since the turn began.

tools.name: list_fo_conversations
tools.description: List the user's previous conversations with Fo across every channel (chat, email, texting, Slack, voice, and this app), newest first, up to 50. Each entry carries a conversationId to pass to get_fo_conversation (read the transcript) or ask_fo (continue the thread). Use it when the user refers to something they discussed with Fo before or asks what they talked about.

conversations.description: Newest first, at most 50. Absent when the user has no Fo conversations.

conversationId.description: Server-issued id; pass it back as conversationId.

title.description: Display name, "Untitled" when the session has none.

channel.description: Originating channel: chat (web, app, or ChatGPT), email, sms, whatsapp, telegram, slack, voice, cron, hook, x.

tools.name: start_fo_call
tools.description: Start a live voice call with Fo from the device the user is on right now (phone or computer, no phone number involved): returns a link the user opens to talk to Fo in the browser. Use it when the user wants to talk to Fo out loud, explain something at length, or have a live back-and-forth. Relay the link to the user as a link to tap. It is personal to them, works once, and expires after 10 minutes; call this again for a fresh link if it was not opened in time.

joinUrl.description: The link the user opens on their device to talk to Fo. Works once.

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339; the link stops working at this time if it has not been opened.
